BitField.name: RXPDMAEN

BitField.description: PDMA Reset
BitField.name: PDMARST

BitField.description: Receive Reset
BitField.name: RXRST

BitField.description: Transmit Reset\nNote: If TX underflow event occurs in QSPI Slave mode, this bit can be used to make QSPI return to idle state.
BitField.name: TXRST

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Threshold Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: RXTHIEN

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Threshold Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: TXTHIEN

BitField.description: Slave Receive Time-out Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: RXTOIEN

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Overrun Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: RXOVIEN

BitField.description: TX Underflow Data Polarity\nNote 1: The TX underflow event occurs if there is no any data in TX FIFO when the slave selection signal is active.\nNote 2: When TX underflow event occurs, QSPIx_MISO pin state will be determined by this setting even though TX FIFO is not empty afterward. Data stored in TX FIFO will be sent through QSPIx_MISO pin in the next transfer frame.
BitField.name: TXUFPOL

BitField.description: TX Underflow Interrupt Enable Bit\nWhen TX underflow event occurs in Slave mode, TXUFIF (QSPIx_STATUS[19]) will be set to 1. This bit is used to enable the TX underflow interrupt.
BitField.name: TXUFIEN

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Buffer Clear\nNote: The RX shift register will not be cleared.
BitField.name: RXFBCLR

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Buffer Clear\nNote: The TX shift register will not be cleared.
BitField.name: TXFBCLR

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Threshold\nIf the valid data count of the receive FIFO buffer is larger than the RXTH setting, the RXTHIF bit will be set to 1, else the RXTHIF bit will be cleared to 0.
BitField.name: RXTH

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Threshold\nIf the valid data count of the transmit FIFO buffer is less than or equal to the TXTH setting, the TXTHIF bit will be set to 1, else the TXTHIF bit will be cleared to 0.
BitField.name: TXTH

BitField.description: Busy Status (Read Only)
BitField.name: BUSY

BitField.description: Unit Transfer Interrupt Flag\nNote: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: UNITIF

BitField.description: Slave Select Active Interrupt Flag\nNote: Only available in Slave mode. This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: SSACTIF

BitField.description: Slave Select Inactive Interrupt Flag\nNote: Only available in Slave mode. This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: SSINAIF

BitField.description: Slave Select Line Bus Status (Read Only)\nNote: This bit is only available in Slave mode. If SSACTPOL (QSPIx_SSCTL[2]) is set 0, and the SSLINE is 1, the QSPI slave select is in inactive status.
BitField.name: SSLINE

BitField.description: Slave Time-out Interrupt Flag \nWhen the slave select is active and the value of SLVTOCNT is not 0, if the bus clock is detected, the slave time-out counter in QSPI controller logic will be started. When the value of time-out counter is greater than or equal to the value of SLVTOCNT (QSPIx_SSCTL[31:16]) before one transaction is done, the slave time-out interrupt event will be asserted.\nNote: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: SLVTOIF

BitField.description: Slave Mode Bit Count Error Interrupt Flag\nIn Slave mode, when the slave select line goes to inactive state, if bit counter is mismatch with DWIDTH, this interrupt flag will be set to 1.\nNote: If the slave select active but there is no any bus clock input, the SLVBEIF also active when the slave select goes to inactive state. This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: SLVBEIF

BitField.description: Slave Mode TX Under Run Interrupt Flag\nIn Slave mode, if TX underflow event occurs and the slave select line goes to inactive state, this interrupt flag will be set to 1.\nNote: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: SLVURIF

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Buffer Empty Indicator (Read Only)
BitField.name: RXEMPTY

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Buffer Full Indicator (Read Only)
BitField.name: RXFULL

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Threshold Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
BitField.name: RXTHIF

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Overrun Interrupt Flag\nWhen the receive FIFO buffer is full, the follow-up data will be dropped and this bit will be set to 1.\nNote: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.

BitField.description: Receive Time-out Interrupt Flag\nNote: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.

BitField.description: QSPI Enable Status (Read Only)\nNote: The QSPI peripheral clock is asynchronous with the system clock. In order to make sure the QSPI control logic is disabled, this bit indicates the real status of QSPI controller.
BitField.name: SPIENSTS

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Buffer Empty Indicator (Read Only)
BitField.name: TXEMPTY

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Buffer Full Indicator (Read Only)
BitField.name: TXFULL

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Threshold Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
BitField.name: TXTHIF

BitField.description:
TX Underflow Interrupt Flag
When the TX underflow event occurs, this bit will be set to 1, the state of data output pin depends on the setting of TXUFPOL.
Note 1: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: If reset slave's transmission circuit when slave selection signal is active, this flag will be set to 1 after 2 peripheral clock cycles + 3 system clock cycles since the reset operation is done.
BitField.name: TXUFIF

BitField.description: TX or RX Reset Status (Read Only)\nNote: Both the reset operations of TXRST and RXRST need 3 system clock cycles + 2 peripheral clock cycles. User can check the status of this bit to monitor the reset function is doing or done.
BitField.name: TXRXRST

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Data Count (Read Only)\nThis bit field indicates the valid data count of receive FIFO buffer.
BitField.name: RXCNT

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Data Count (Read Only)\nThis bit field indicates the valid data count of transmit FIFO buffer.
BitField.name: TXCNT

BitField.description:
Data Transmit Register
The data transmit registers pass through the transmitted data into the 8-level transmit FIFO buffers. The number of valid bits depends on the setting of DWIDTH (QSPIx_CTL[12:8]).
If DWIDTH is set to 0x08, the bits TX[7:0] will be transmitted. If DWIDTH is set to 0x00, the QSPI controller will perform a 32-bit transfer.
Note: In Master mode, QSPI controller will start to transfer the QSPI bus clock after 1 APB clock and 6 peripheral clock cycles after user writes to this register.
BitField.name: TX

BitField.description: Data Receive Register (Read Only)\nThere are 8-level FIFO buffers in this controller. The data receive register holds the data received from QSPI data input pin. If the RXEMPTY (QSPIx_STATUS[8) is not set to 1, the receive FIFO buffers can be accessed through software by reading this register.
BitField.name: RX

BitField.description: Assert Acknowledge Control
BitField.name: AA

BitField.description: I2C Interrupt Flag\nWhen a new I2C state is present in the I2C_STATUS0 register, the SI flag is set by hardware. If bit INTEN (I2C_CTL0 [7]) is set, the I2C interrupt is requested. SI must be cleared by software. Clear SI by writing 1 to this bit.\nFor ACKMEN is set in slave read mode, the SI flag is set in 8th clock period for user to confirm the acknowledge bit and 9th clock period for user to read the data in the data buffer.
BitField.name: SI

BitField.description: I2C STOP Control\nIn Master mode, setting STO to transmit a STOP condition to bus then I2C controller will check the bus condition if a STOP condition is detected. This bit will be cleared by hardware automatically.
BitField.name: STO

BitField.description: I2C START Control\nSetting STA to logic 1 to enter Master mode, the I2C hardware sends a START or Repeat START condition to bus when the bus is free.
BitField.name: STA

BitField.description: I2C Controller Enable Bit
BitField.name: I2CEN

BitField.description: Enable Interrupt
BitField.name: INTEN

BitField.description: General Call Function
BitField.name: GC

BitField.description: I2C Address \nThe content of this register is irrelevant when I2C is in Master mode. In the slave mode, the seven most significant bits must be loaded with the chip's own address. The I2C hardware will react if either of the address is matched.\nNote: When software sets 10'h000, the address cannot be used.
BitField.name: ADDR

BitField.description: I2C Data \nBit [7:0] is located with the 8-bit transferred/received data of I2C serial port.
BitField.name: DAT

BitField.description: I2C Status
BitField.name: STATUS

BitField.description: I2C Clock Divided \nNote: The minimum value of I2C_CLKDIV is 4.
BitField.name: DIVIDER

BitField.description: Noise Filter Count \nThe register bits control the input filter width.\nNote: Filter width Min :3*PCLK, Max : 18*PCLK
BitField.name: NFCNT

BitField.description: Time-out Flag\nThis bit is set by hardware when I2C time-out happened and it can interrupt CPU if I2C interrupt enable bit (INTEN) is set to 1.\nNote: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: TOIF

BitField.description: Time-out Counter Input Clock Divided by 4\nWhen enabled, the time-out period is extended 4 times.
BitField.name: TOCDIV4

BitField.description: Time-out Counter Enable Bit\nWhen enabled, the 14-bit time-out counter will start counting when SI is cleared. Setting flag SI to '1' will reset counter and re-start up counting after SI is cleared.
BitField.name: TOCEN

BitField.description: I2C Address Mask\nI2C bus controllers support multiple address recognition with four address mask register. When the bit in the address mask register is set to one, it means the received corresponding address bit is don't-care. If the bit is set to zero, that means the received corresponding register bit should be exact the same as address register.\nNote: The wake-up function cannot use address mask.
BitField.name: ADDRMSK

BitField.description: I2C Wake-up Enable Bit
BitField.name: WKEN

BitField.description: I2C No Hold BUS Enable Bit\nNote: The I2C controller could respond when WKIF event is not clear, it may cause error data transmitted or received. If data transmitted or received when WKIF event is not clear, user must reset I2C controller and execute the original operation again.
BitField.name: NHDBUSEN

BitField.description: I2C Wake-up Flag\nWhen chip is woken up from Power-down mode by I2C, this bit is set to 1. Software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: WKIF

BitField.description: Wakeup Address Frame Acknowledge Bit Done\nNote: This bit cannot release WKIF. Software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: WKAKDONE

BitField.name: ADMAT0

BitField.name: ADMAT1

BitField.description: I2C Address 2 Match Status\nWhen address 2 is matched, hardware will inform which address used. This bit will set to 1, and software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: ADMAT2

BitField.description: I2C Address 3 Match Status\nWhen address 3 is matched, hardware will inform which address used. This bit will set to 1, and software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: ADMAT3

BitField.description: On Bus Busy (Read Only)\nIndicates that a communication is in progress on the bus. It is set by hardware when a START condition is detected. It is cleared by hardware when a STOP condition is detected.
BitField.name: ONBUSY

BitField.description: Setup Time Configure Control\nThis field is used to generate a delay timing between SDA falling edge and SCL rising edge in transmission mode.\nNote: Setup time setting should not make SCL output less than three PCLKs.
BitField.name: STCTL

BitField.description: Hold Time Configure Control \nThis field is used to generate the delay timing between SCL falling edge and SDA rising edge in transmission mode.
BitField.name: HTCTL

BitField.description: Acknowledge Control by Manual\nIn order to allow ACK control in slave reception including the command and data, slave byte control mode must be enabled by setting the ACKMEN bit.
BitField.name: ACKMEN

BitField.description: Packet Error Checking Calculation Enable Bit\nNote: When I2C enters Power-down mode, the bit should be enabled after wake-up if needed PEC calculation.

BitField.description: Packet Error Checking Byte Transmission/Reception

BitField.description: Timer Check in Idle State\nThe BUSTOUT is used to calculate the time-out of clock low in bus active and the idle period in bus Idle. This bit is used to define which condition is enabled.\nNote: The BUSY (I2C_BUSSTS[0]) indicate the current bus state.
BitField.name: TIDLE

BitField.description: PEC Clear at Repeat \nThe calculation of PEC starts when PECEN is set to 1 and it is cleared when the STA or STO bit is detected. This PECCLR bit used to enable the condition of Repeat START can clear the PEC calculation.

BitField.description: Clock Low Cumulate Time-out Status \nNote: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

The I2C hardware will react if either of the address is matched.\nNote: When software sets 10'h000, the address cannot be used.

BitField.description: I2C Clock Divided \nNote: The minimum value of I2C_CLKDIV is 4.
BitField.name: DIVIDER

BitField.description: Noise Filter Count \nThe register bits control the input filter width.\nNote: Filter width Min :3*PCLK, Max : 18*PCLK
BitField.name: NFCNT

BitField.description: Time-out Flag\nThis bit is set by hardware when I2C time-out happened and it can interrupt CPU if I2C interrupt enable bit (INTEN) is set to 1.\nNote: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: TOIF

BitField.description: Time-out Counter Input Clock Divided by 4\nWhen enabled, the time-out period is extended 4 times.
BitField.name: TOCDIV4

BitField.description: Time-out Counter Enable Bit\nWhen enabled, the 14-bit time-out counter will start counting when SI is cleared. Setting flag SI to '1' will reset counter and re-start up counting after SI is cleared.
BitField.name: TOCEN

BitField.description: I2C Address Mask\nI2C bus controllers support multiple address recognition with four address mask register. When the bit in the address mask register is set to one, it means the received corresponding address bit is don't-care. If the bit is set to zero, that means the received corresponding register bit should be exact the same as address register.\nNote: The wake-up function cannot use address mask.
BitField.name: ADDRMSK

BitField.description: I2C Wake-up Enable Bit
BitField.name: WKEN

BitField.description: I2C No Hold BUS Enable Bit\nNote: The I2C controller could respond when WKIF event is not clear, it may cause error data transmitted or received. If data transmitted or received when WKIF event is not clear, user must reset I2C controller and execute the original operation again.
BitField.name: NHDBUSEN

BitField.description: I2C Wake-up Flag\nWhen chip is woken up from Power-down mode by I2C, this bit is set to 1. Software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: WKIF

BitField.description: Wakeup Address Frame Acknowledge Bit Done\nNote: This bit cannot release WKIF. Software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: WKAKDONE

BitField.description: Read/Write Status Bit in Address Wakeup Frame (Read Only)\nNote: This bit will be cleared when software can write 1 to WKAKDONE (I2C_WKSTS[1]) bit.
BitField.name: WRSTSWK

BitField.description: PDMA Transmit Channel Available
BitField.name: TXPDMAEN

BitField.description: PDMA Receive Channel Available
BitField.name: RXPDMAEN

BitField.description: PDMA Reset
BitField.name: PDMARST

BitField.description: PDMA Stretch Bit
BitField.name: PDMASTR

BitField.description: Address 10-bit Function Enable Bit
BitField.name: ADDR10EN

BitField.description: I2C Address 0 Match Status\nWhen address 0 is matched, hardware will inform which address used. This bit will set to 1, and software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: ADMAT0

BitField.description: I2C Address 1 Match Status\nWhen address 1 is matched, hardware will inform which address used. This bit will set to 1, and software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: ADMAT1

BitField.description: I2C Address 2 Match Status\nWhen address 2 is matched, hardware will inform which address used. This bit will set to 1, and software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: ADMAT2

BitField.description: I2C Address 3 Match Status\nWhen address 3 is matched, hardware will inform which address used. This bit will set to 1, and software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: ADMAT3

BitField.description: On Bus Busy (Read Only)\nIndicates that a communication is in progress on the bus. It is set by hardware when a START condition is detected. It is cleared by hardware when a STOP condition is detected.
BitField.name: ONBUSY

BitField.description: Setup Time Configure Control\nThis field is used to generate a delay timing between SDA falling edge and SCL rising edge in transmission mode.\nNote: Setup time setting should not make SCL output less than three PCLKs.
BitField.name: STCTL

BitField.description: Hold Time Configure Control \nThis field is used to generate the delay timing between SCL falling edge and SDA rising edge in transmission mode.
BitField.name: HTCTL

BitField.description: Acknowledge Control by Manual\nIn order to allow ACK control in slave reception including the command and data, slave byte control mode must be enabled by setting the ACKMEN bit.
BitField.name: ACKMEN

BitField.description: Packet Error Checking Calculation Enable Bit\nNote: When I2C enters Power-down mode, the bit should be enabled after wake-up if needed PEC calculation.
BitField.name: PECEN

BitField.description: Bus Management Device Default Address Enable Bit
BitField.name: BMDEN

BitField.description: Bus Management Host Enable Bit
BitField.name: BMHEN

BitField.description: Bus Management Alert Enable Bit
BitField.name: ALERTEN

BitField.description: Suspend/Control Data Output Status
BitField.name: SCTLOSTS

BitField.description: Suspend or Control Pin Output Enable Bit
BitField.name: SCTLOEN

BitField.description: BUS Enable Bit\nNote: When the bit is enabled, the internal 14-bit counter is used to calculate the time out event of clock low condition.
BitField.name: BUSEN

BitField.description: Packet Error Checking Byte Transmission/Reception
BitField.name: PECTXEN

BitField.description: Timer Check in Idle State\nThe BUSTOUT is used to calculate the time-out of clock low in bus active and the idle period in bus Idle. This bit is used to define which condition is enabled.\nNote: The BUSY (I2C_BUSSTS[0]) indicate the current bus state.
BitField.name: TIDLE

BitField.description: PEC Clear at Repeat \nThe calculation of PEC starts when PECEN is set to 1 and it is cleared when the STA or STO bit is detected. This PECCLR bit used to enable the condition of Repeat START can clear the PEC calculation.
BitField.name: PECCLR

BitField.description: Acknowledge Manual Enable Extra SI Interrupt
BitField.name: ACKM9SI

BitField.description: Packet Error Checking Byte Count Done Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: BCDIEN

BitField.description: Packet Error Checking Byte Transfer Done Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: PECDIEN

Register.description: I2C Bus Management Timer Control Register
Register.name: I2C_BUSTCTL

BitField.description: Bus Time Out Enable Bit
BitField.name: BUSTOEN

BitField.description: Cumulative Clock Low Time Out Enable Bit\nFor Master, it calculates the period from START to ACK.\nFor Slave, it calculates the period from START to STOP.
BitField.name: CLKTOEN

BitField.description: Time-out Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: BUSTOIEN

BitField.description: Extended Clock Time Out Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: CLKTOIEN

BitField.description: Time Out Reset Enable Bit
BitField.name: TORSTEN

BitField.description: Bus Busy (Read Only)\nIndicates that a communication is in progress on the bus. It is set by hardware when a START condition is detected. It is cleared by hardware when a STOP condition is detected
BitField.name: BUSY

BitField.description: Byte Count Transmission/Receive Done \nNote: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: BCDONE

BitField.description: PEC Error in Reception \nNote: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: PECERR

BitField.description: SMBus Alert Status \nNote: 1. The SMBALERT pin is an open-drain pin, the pull-high resistor is must in the system. 2. Software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: ALERT

BitField.description: Bus Suspend or Control Signal Input Status (Read Only)
BitField.name: SCTLDIN

BitField.description: Bus Time-out Status \nIn bus busy, the bit indicates the total clock low time-out event occurred; otherwise, it indicates the bus idle time-out event occurred.\nNote: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: BUSTO

BitField.description: Clock Low Cumulate Time-out Status \nNote: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: CLKTO

BitField.description: PEC Byte Transmission/Receive Done \nNote: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: PECDONE

Register.description: I2C Packet Error Checking Byte Number Register
Register.name: I2C_PKTSIZE

BitField.description: Transfer Byte Number\nThe transmission or receive byte number in one transaction when the PECEN is set. The maximum transaction or receive byte is 256 Bytes.\nNote: The byte number counting includes address, command code, and data frame.
BitField.name: PLDSIZE

Register.description: I2C Packet Error Checking Byte Value Register
Register.name: I2C_PKTCRC

BitField.description: Packet Error Checking Byte Value
BitField.name: PECCRC

BitField.description: Bus Management Time-out Value\nIndicates the bus time-out value in bus is IDLE or SCLK low.\nNote: If the user wants to revise the value of BUSTOUT, the TORSTEN (I2C_BUSTCTL[4]) bit shall be set to 1 and clear to 0 first in the BUSEN(I2C_BUSCTL[7]) is set.
BitField.name: BUSTO

Register.description: I2C Bus Management Clock Low Timer Register
Register.name: I2C_CLKTOUT

BitField.description: Bus Clock Low Timer\nThe field is used to configure the cumulative clock extension time-out.\nNote: If the user wants to revise the value of CLKLTOUT, the TORSTEN bit shall be set to 1 and clear to 0 first in the BUSEN is set.
BitField.name: CLKTO

BitField.description: Function Mode\nThis bit field selects the protocol for this USCI controller. Selecting a protocol that is not available or a reserved combination disables the USCI. When switching between two protocols, the USCI has to be disabled before selecting a new protocol. Simultaneously, the USCI will be reset when user write 000 to FUNMODE.
BitField.name: FUNMODE

BitField.description: Transmit Start Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a transmit start event.
BitField.name: TXSTIEN

BitField.description: Transmit End Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a transmit finish event.
BitField.name: TXENDIEN

BitField.description: Receive Start Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a receive start event.
BitField.name: RXSTIEN

BitField.description: Receive End Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a receive finish event.
BitField.name: RXENDIEN

BitField.description: Reference Clock Source Selection\nThis bit selects the source signal of reference clock (fREF_CLK).
BitField.name: RCLKSEL

BitField.description: Protocol Clock Source Selection\nThis bit selects the source signal of protocol clock (fPROT_CLK).
BitField.name: PTCLKSEL

BitField.description: Sample Clock Source Selection\nThis bit field used for the clock source selection of a sample clock (fSAMP_CLK) for the protocol processor.
BitField.name: SPCLKSEL

BitField.description: Timing Measurement Counter Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the 10-bit timing measurement counter.
BitField.name: TMCNTEN

BitField.description: Timing Measurement Counter Clock Source Selection
BitField.name: TMCNTSRC

BitField.description: Pre-divider for Sample Counter
BitField.name: PDSCNT

BitField.description: Denominator for Sample Counter\nThis bit field defines the divide ratio of the sample clock fSAMP_CLK.\nNote: The maximum value of DSCNT is 0xF on UART mode and suggest to set over 4 to confirm the receiver data is sampled in right value.
BitField.name: DSCNT

BitField.description: Clock Divider\nNote: In UART function, it can be updated by hardware in the 4th falling edge of the input data 0x55 when the auto baud rate function (ABREN(UUART_PROTCTL[6])) is enabled. The revised value is the average bit time between bit 5 and bit 6. The user can use revised CLKDIV and new BRDETITV (UUART_PROTCTL[24:16]) to calculate the precise baud rate.
BitField.name: CLKDIV

Register.description: USCI Input Data Signal Configuration Register 0
Register.name: UUART_DATIN0

BitField.description: Input Signal Synchronization Selection\nThis bit selects if the un-synchronized input signal (with optionally inverted) or the synchronized (and optionally filtered) signal can be used as input for the data shift unit.
BitField.name: SYNCSEL

BitField.description: Input Signal Inverse Selection\nThis bit defines the inverter enable of the input asynchronous signal.
BitField.name: ININV

BitField.description: Input Signal Edge Detection Mode\nThis bit field selects which edge actives the trigger event of input data signal.\nNote: In UART function mode, it is suggested to set this bit field as 0x2.
BitField.name: EDGEDET

Register.description: USCI Input Control Signal Configuration Register 0
Register.name: UUART_CTLIN0

BitField.description: Input Synchronization Signal Selection\nThis bit selects if the un-synchronized input signal (with optionally inverted) or the synchronized (and optionally filtered) signal can be used as input for the data shift unit.
BitField.name: SYNCSEL

BitField.description: Input Signal Inverse Selection\nThis bit defines the inverter enable of the input asynchronous signal.
BitField.name: ININV

Register.description: USCI Input Clock Signal Configuration Register
Register.name: UUART_CLKIN

BitField.description: Input Synchronization Signal Selection\nThis bit selects if the un-synchronized input signal or the synchronized (and optionally filtered) signal can be used as input for the data shift unit.
BitField.name: SYNCSEL

BitField.description: LSB First Transmission Selection
BitField.name: LSB

BitField.description: Data Output Inverse Selection\nThis bit defines the relation between the internal shift data value and the output data signal of USCIx_DAT1 pin.
BitField.name: DATOINV

BitField.description: Control Signal Output Inverse Selection\nThis bit defines the relation between the internal control signal and the output control signal.\nNote: In UART protocol, the control signal means nRTS signal.
BitField.name: CTLOINV

BitField.description: Word Length of Transmission\nThis bit field defines the data word length (amount of bits) for reception and transmission. The data word is always right-aligned in the data buffer. USCI support word length from 4 to 16 bits.\nNote: In UART protocol, the length can be configured as 6~13 bits.
BitField.name: DWIDTH

BitField.description: Transmit Data\nSoftware can use this bit field to write 16-bit transmit data for transmission.
BitField.name: TXDAT

BitField.description: Received Data\nThis bit field monitors the received data which stored in receive data buffer.\nNote: RXDAT[15:13] indicate the same frame status of BREAK, FRMERR and PARITYERR (UUART_PROTSTS[7:5]).
BitField.name: RXDAT

BitField.description: Clear Transmit Buffer \nNote: It is cleared automatically after one PCLK cycle.
BitField.name: TXCLR

BitField.description: Receive Buffer Overrun Error Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: RXOVIEN

BitField.description: Clear Receive Buffer\nNote: It is cleared automatically after one PCLK cycle.
BitField.name: RXCLR

BitField.description: Transmit Reset\nNote: It is cleared automatically after one PCLK cycle.
BitField.name: TXRST

BitField.description: Receive Reset\nNote 1: It is cleared automatically after one PCLK cycle.\nNote 2: It is suggested to check the RXBUSY (UUART_PROTSTS[10]) before this bit will be set to 1.
BitField.name: RXRST

BitField.description: Receive Buffer Empty Indicator (Read Only)
BitField.name: RXEMPTY

BitField.description: Receive Buffer Full Indicator (Read Only)
BitField.name: RXFULL

BitField.description: Receive Buffer Over-run Error Interrupt Status\nThis bit indicates that a receive buffer overrun error event has been detected. If RXOVIEN (UUART_BUFCTL[14]) is enabled, the corresponding interrupt request is activated. \nNote: It is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit.
BitField.name: RXOVIF

BitField.description: Transmit Buffer Empty Indicator (Read Only)
BitField.name: TXEMPTY

BitField.description: Transmit Buffer Full Indicator (Read Only)
BitField.name: TXFULL

BitField.description: PDMA Reset
BitField.name: PDMARST

BitField.description: PDMA Transmit Channel Available
BitField.name: TXPDMAEN

BitField.description: PDMA Receive Channel Available
BitField.name: RXPDMAEN

BitField.description: PDMA Mode Enable Bit
BitField.name: PDMAEN

BitField.description: Wake-up Enable Bit
BitField.name: WKEN

BitField.description: Power Down Blocking Option
BitField.name: PDBOPT

BitField.description: Wake-up Flag\nWhen chip is woken up from Power-down mode, this bit is set to 1. Software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: WKF

BitField.description: Stop Bits\nThis bit defines the number of stop bits in an UART frame.
BitField.name: STOPB

BitField.description: Parity Enable Bit\nThis bit defines the parity bit is enabled in an UART frame.
BitField.name: PARITYEN

BitField.description: Even Parity Enable Bit\nNote: This bit has effect only when PARITYEN is set.
BitField.name: EVENPARITY

BitField.description: nRTS Auto-flow Control Enable Bit\nNote: This bit has effect only when the RTSAUDIREN is not set.
BitField.name: RTSAUTOEN

BitField.description: nCTS Auto-flow Control Enable Bit\nWhen nCTS auto-flow is enabled, the UART will send data to external device when nCTS input assert (UART will not send data to device if nCTS input is dis-asserted).
BitField.name: CTSAUTOEN

BitField.description:
nRTS Auto Direction Enable Bit
When nRTS auto direction is enabled, if the transmitted bytes in the TX buffer is empty, the nRTS signal is inactive automatically.
Note 1: This bit is used for nRTS auto direction control for RS485.
Note 2: This bit has effect only when the RTSAUTOEN is not set.
BitField.name: RTSAUDIREN

BitField.description: Auto-baud Rate Detect Enable Bit\nNote: When the auto - baud rate detect operation finishes, hardware will clear this bit. The associated interrupt ABRDETIF (UUART_PROTSTS[9]) will be generated (If ARBIEN (UUART_PROTIEN [1]) is enabled).
BitField.name: ABREN

BitField.description: Data Wake-up Mode Enable Bit
BitField.name: DATWKEN

BitField.description: nCTS Wake-up Mode Enable Bit
BitField.name: CTSWKEN

BitField.description: Wake-up Counter\nThese bits field indicate how many clock cycle selected by fPDS_CNT do the slave can get the 1st bit (start bit) when the device is woken up from Power-down mode.
BitField.name: WAKECNT

BitField.description: Baud Rate Detection Interval \nThis bit fields indicate how many clock cycle selected by TMCNTSRC (UUART_BRGEN [5]) does the slave calculates the baud rate in one bits. The order of the bus shall be 1 and 0 step by step (e.g. the input data pattern shall be 0x55). The user can read the value to know the current input baud rate of the bus whenever the ABRDETIF (UUART_PROTCTL[9]) is set.\nNote: This bit can be cleared to 0 by software writing '0' to the BRDETITV.
BitField.name: BRDETITV

BitField.description: Stick Parity Enable Bit\nNote: Refer to RS-485 Support section for detailed information.
BitField.name: STICKEN

BitField.description: Transmit Break Control Enable Bit\nNote: When this bit is set to logic 1, the serial data output (TX) is forced to the Spacing State (logic 0). This bit acts only on TX line and has no effect on the receiver logic.
BitField.name: BCEN

BitField.description: Deglitch Enable Bit\nNote 1: When this bit is set to logic 1, any pulse width less than about 150 ns will be considered a glitch and will be removed in the serial data input (RX). This bit acts only on RX line and has no effect on the transmitter logic.\nNote 2: It is recommended to set this bit only when operating at baud rate under 2.5 Mbps.
BitField.name: DGE

BitField.description: UART Protocol Enable Bit
BitField.name: PROTEN

BitField.description: Auto-baud Rate Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: ABRIEN

BitField.description: Receive Line Status Interrupt Enable Bit\nNote: UUART_PROTSTS[7:5] indicates the current interrupt event for receive line status interrupt.
BitField.name: RLSIEN

BitField.description: Transmit Start Interrupt Flag\nNote 1: It is cleared by software writing one into this bit.\nNote 2: Used for user to load next transmit data when there is no data in transmit buffer.
BitField.name: TXSTIF

BitField.description: Transmit End Interrupt Flag\nNote: It is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit.
BitField.name: TXENDIF

BitField.description: Receive Start Interrupt Flag\nNote: It is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit.
BitField.name: RXSTIF

BitField.description: Receive End Interrupt Flag\nNote: It is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit.
BitField.name: RXENDIF

BitField.description: Parity Error Flag\nThis bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received character does not have a valid 'parity bit'.\nNote: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' among the BREAK, FRMERR and PARITYERR bits.
BitField.name: PARITYERR

BitField.description: Framing Error Flag\nThis bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received character does not have a valid 'stop bit' (that is, the stop bit following the last data bit or parity bit is detected as logic 0).\nNote: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' among the BREAK, FRMERR and PARITYERR bits.
BitField.name: FRMERR

BitField.description: Break Flag\nThis bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received data input (RX) is held in the 'spacing state' (logic 0) for longer than a full word transmission time (that is, the total time of 'start bit' + data bits + parity + stop bits).\nNote: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' among the BREAK, FRMERR and PARITYERR bits.
BitField.name: BREAK

BitField.description: Auto-baud Rate Interrupt Flag \nThis bit is set when auto-baud rate detection is done among the falling edge of the input data. If the ABRIEN (UUART_PROTCTL[6]) is set, the auto-baud rate interrupt will be generated. This bit can be set 4 times when the input data pattern is 0x55 and it is cleared before the next falling edge of the input bus.\nNote: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.
BitField.name: ABRDETIF

BitField.description: RX Bus Status Flag (Read Only) \nThis bit indicates the busy status of the receiver.
BitField.name: RXBUSY

BitField.description:
Auto-baud Rate Error Status 
This bit is set when auto-baud rate detection counter overrun. When the auto-baud rate counter overrun, the user shall revise the CLKDIV (UUART_BRGEN[25:16]) value and enable ABREN (UUART_PROTCTL[6]) to detect the correct baud rate again.
Note 1: This bit is set at the same time of ABRDETIF.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to ABRDETIF or ABERRSTS.
BitField.name: ABERRSTS

BitField.description: nCTS Synchronized Level Status (Read Only)\nThis bit used to indicate the current status of the internal synchronized nCTS signal.
BitField.name: CTSSYNCLV

BitField.description: nCTS Pin Status (Read Only)\nThis bit used to monitor the current status of nCTS pin input.
BitField.name: CTSLV

BitField.description: Function Mode\nThis bit field selects the protocol for this USCI controller. Selecting a protocol that is not available or a reserved combination disables the USCI. When switching between two protocols, the USCI has to be disabled before selecting a new protocol. Simultaneously, the USCI will be reset when user write 000 to FUNMODE.
BitField.name: FUNMODE

BitField.name: TXSTIEN

BitField.description: Transmit End Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a transmit finish event.
BitField.name: TXENDIEN

BitField.description: Receive Start Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a receive start event.
BitField.name: RXSTIEN

BitField.description: Receive End Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a receive finish event.
BitField.name: RXENDIEN

BitField.description: Reference Clock Source Selection\nThis bit selects the source signal of reference clock (fREF_CLK).
BitField.name: RCLKSEL

BitField.description: Protocol Clock Source Selection\nThis bit selects the source signal of protocol clock (fPROT_CLK).
BitField.name: PTCLKSEL

BitField.description: Sample Clock Source Selection\nThis bit field used for the clock source selection of a sample clock (fSAMP_CLK) for the protocol processor.
BitField.name: SPCLKSEL

BitField.description: Timing Measurement Counter Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the 10-bit timing measurement counter.
BitField.name: TMCNTEN

BitField.description: Timing Measurement Counter Clock Source Selection
BitField.name: TMCNTSRC

BitField.description: Pre-divider for Sample Counter
BitField.name: PDSCNT

BitField.description: Denominator for Sample Counter\nThis bit field defines the divide ratio of the sample clock fSAMP_CLK.\nNote: The maximum value of DSCNT is 0xF on UART mode and suggest to set over 4 to confirm the receiver data is sampled in right value.
BitField.name: DSCNT

BitField.description: Clock Divider\nNote: In UART function, it can be updated by hardware in the 4th falling edge of the input data 0x55 when the auto baud rate function (ABREN(UUART_PROTCTL[6])) is enabled. The revised value is the average bit time between bit 5 and bit 6. The user can use revised CLKDIV and new BRDETITV (UUART_PROTCTL[24:16]) to calculate the precise baud rate.

BitField.name: RXPDMAEN

BitField.description: PDMA Mode Enable Bit
BitField.name: PDMAEN

BitField.description: Wake-up Enable Bit
BitField.name: WKEN

BitField.description: Power Down Blocking Option
BitField.name: PDBOPT

BitField.description: Wake-up Flag\nWhen chip is woken up from Power-down mode, this bit is set to 1. Software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: WKF

BitField.description: Stop Bits\nThis bit defines the number of stop bits in an UART frame.
BitField.name: STOPB

BitField.description: Parity Enable Bit\nThis bit defines the parity bit is enabled in an UART frame.
BitField.name: PARITYEN

BitField.description: Even Parity Enable Bit\nNote: This bit has effect only when PARITYEN is set.
BitField.name: EVENPARITY

BitField.description: nRTS Auto-flow Control Enable Bit\nNote: This bit has effect only when the RTSAUDIREN is not set.
BitField.name: RTSAUTOEN

BitField.description: nCTS Auto-flow Control Enable Bit\nWhen nCTS auto-flow is enabled, the UART will send data to external device when nCTS input assert (UART will not send data to device if nCTS input is dis-asserted).
BitField.name: CTSAUTOEN

BitField.description:
nRTS Auto Direction Enable Bit
When nRTS auto direction is enabled, if the transmitted bytes in the TX buffer is empty, the nRTS signal is inactive automatically.
Note 1: This bit is used for nRTS auto direction control for RS485.
Note 2: This bit has effect only when the RTSAUTOEN is not set.
BitField.name: RTSAUDIREN

BitField.description: Auto-baud Rate Detect Enable Bit\nNote: When the auto - baud rate detect operation finishes, hardware will clear this bit. The associated interrupt ABRDETIF (UUART_PROTSTS[9]) will be generated (If ARBIEN (UUART_PROTIEN [1]) is enabled).
BitField.name: ABREN

BitField.description: Data Wake-up Mode Enable Bit
BitField.name: DATWKEN

BitField.description: nCTS Wake-up Mode Enable Bit
BitField.name: CTSWKEN

BitField.description: Wake-up Counter\nThese bits field indicate how many clock cycle selected by fPDS_CNT do the slave can get the 1st bit (start bit) when the device is woken up from Power-down mode.
BitField.name: WAKECNT

BitField.description: Baud Rate Detection Interval \nThis bit fields indicate how many clock cycle selected by TMCNTSRC (UUART_BRGEN [5]) does the slave calculates the baud rate in one bits. The order of the bus shall be 1 and 0 step by step (e.g. the input data pattern shall be 0x55). The user can read the value to know the current input baud rate of the bus whenever the ABRDETIF (UUART_PROTCTL[9]) is set.\nNote: This bit can be cleared to 0 by software writing '0' to the BRDETITV.
BitField.name: BRDETITV

BitField.description: Stick Parity Enable Bit\nNote: Refer to RS-485 Support section for detailed information.
BitField.name: STICKEN

BitField.description: Transmit Break Control Enable Bit\nNote: When this bit is set to logic 1, the serial data output (TX) is forced to the Spacing State (logic 0). This bit acts only on TX line and has no effect on the receiver logic.
BitField.name: BCEN

BitField.description: Deglitch Enable Bit\nNote 1: When this bit is set to logic 1, any pulse width less than about 150 ns will be considered a glitch and will be removed in the serial data input (RX). This bit acts only on RX line and has no effect on the transmitter logic.\nNote 2: It is recommended to set this bit only when operating at baud rate under 2.5 Mbps.
BitField.name: DGE

BitField.description: UART Protocol Enable Bit
BitField.name: PROTEN

BitField.description: Auto-baud Rate Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: ABRIEN

BitField.description: Receive Line Status Interrupt Enable Bit\nNote: UUART_PROTSTS[7:5] indicates the current interrupt event for receive line status interrupt.
BitField.name: RLSIEN

BitField.description: Transmit Start Interrupt Flag\nNote 1: It is cleared by software writing one into this bit.\nNote 2: Used for user to load next transmit data when there is no data in transmit buffer.
BitField.name: TXSTIF

BitField.description: Transmit End Interrupt Flag\nNote: It is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit.
BitField.name: TXENDIF

BitField.description: Receive Start Interrupt Flag\nNote: It is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit.
BitField.name: RXSTIF

BitField.description: Receive End Interrupt Flag\nNote: It is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit.
BitField.name: RXENDIF

BitField.description: Parity Error Flag\nThis bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received character does not have a valid 'parity bit'.\nNote: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' among the BREAK, FRMERR and PARITYERR bits.
BitField.name: PARITYERR

BitField.description: Framing Error Flag\nThis bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received character does not have a valid 'stop bit' (that is, the stop bit following the last data bit or parity bit is detected as logic 0).\nNote: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' among the BREAK, FRMERR and PARITYERR bits.
BitField.name: FRMERR

BitField.description: Break Flag\nThis bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received data input (RX) is held in the 'spacing state' (logic 0) for longer than a full word transmission time (that is, the total time of 'start bit' + data bits + parity + stop bits).\nNote: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' among the BREAK, FRMERR and PARITYERR bits.
BitField.name: BREAK

BitField.description: Auto-baud Rate Interrupt Flag \nThis bit is set when auto-baud rate detection is done among the falling edge of the input data. If the ABRIEN (UUART_PROTCTL[6]) is set, the auto-baud rate interrupt will be generated. This bit can be set 4 times when the input data pattern is 0x55 and it is cleared before the next falling edge of the input bus.\nNote: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.
BitField.name: ABRDETIF

BitField.description: RX Bus Status Flag (Read Only) \nThis bit indicates the busy status of the receiver.
BitField.name: RXBUSY

BitField.description:
Auto-baud Rate Error Status 
This bit is set when auto-baud rate detection counter overrun. When the auto-baud rate counter overrun, the user shall revise the CLKDIV (UUART_BRGEN[25:16]) value and enable ABREN (UUART_PROTCTL[6]) to detect the correct baud rate again.
Note 1: This bit is set at the same time of ABRDETIF.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to ABRDETIF or ABERRSTS.
BitField.name: ABERRSTS

BitField.description: nCTS Synchronized Level Status (Read Only)\nThis bit used to indicate the current status of the internal synchronized nCTS signal.
BitField.name: CTSSYNCLV

BitField.description: nCTS Pin Status (Read Only)\nThis bit used to monitor the current status of nCTS pin input.
BitField.name: CTSLV

BitField.description: Function Mode\nThis bit field selects the protocol for this USCI controller. Selecting a protocol that is not available or a reserved combination disables the USCI. When switching between two protocols, the USCI has to be disabled before selecting a new protocol. Simultaneously, the USCI will be reset when user write 000 to FUNMODE.
BitField.name: FUNMODE

BitField.description: Transmit Start Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a transmit start event.
BitField.name: TXSTIEN

BitField.description: Transmit End Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a transmit finish event.
BitField.name: TXENDIEN

BitField.description: Receive Start Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a receive start event.
BitField.name: RXSTIEN

BitField.description: Receive End Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a receive finish event.
BitField.name: RXENDIEN

BitField.description: Reference Clock Source Selection\nThis bit selects the source signal of reference clock (fREF_CLK).
BitField.name: RCLKSEL

BitField.description: Protocol Clock Source Selection\nThis bit selects the source signal of protocol clock (fPROT_CLK).
BitField.name: PTCLKSEL

BitField.description: Sample Clock Source Selection\nThis bit field used for the clock source selection of a sample clock (fSAMP_CLK) for the protocol processor.
BitField.name: SPCLKSEL

BitField.description: Timing Measurement Counter Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the 10-bit timing measurement counter.
BitField.name: TMCNTEN

BitField.description: Timing Measurement Counter Clock Source Selection
BitField.name: TMCNTSRC

BitField.description: Pre-divider for Sample Counter
BitField.name: PDSCNT

BitField.description: Denominator for Sample Counter\nThis bit field defines the divide ratio of the sample clock fSAMP_CLK.\nNote: The maximum value of DSCNT is 0xF on UART mode and suggest to set over 4 to confirm the receiver data is sampled in right value.
BitField.name: DSCNT

BitField.description: Clock Divider\nNote: In UART function, it can be updated by hardware in the 4th falling edge of the input data 0x55 when the auto baud rate function (ABREN(UUART_PROTCTL[6])) is enabled. The revised value is the average bit time between bit 5 and bit 6. The user can use revised CLKDIV and new BRDETITV (UUART_PROTCTL[24:16]) to calculate the precise baud rate.
BitField.name: CLKDIV

Register.description: USCI Input Data Signal Configuration Register 0
Register.name: UUART_DATIN0

BitField.description: Input Signal Synchronization Selection\nThis bit selects if the un-synchronized input signal (with optionally inverted) or the synchronized (and optionally filtered) signal can be used as input for the data shift unit.
BitField.name: SYNCSEL

BitField.description: Input Signal Inverse Selection\nThis bit defines the inverter enable of the input asynchronous signal.
BitField.name: ININV

BitField.description: Input Signal Edge Detection Mode\nThis bit field selects which edge actives the trigger event of input data signal.\nNote: In UART function mode, it is suggested to set this bit field as 0x2.

The data word is always right-aligned in the data buffer. USCI support word length from 4 to 16 bits.\nNote: In UART protocol, the length can be configured as 6~13 bits.

BitField.description: Received Data\nThis bit field monitors the received data which stored in receive data buffer.\nNote: RXDAT[15:13] indicate the same frame status of BREAK, FRMERR and PARITYERR (UUART_PROTSTS[7:5]).

BitField.description: Clear Transmit Buffer \nNote: It is cleared automatically after one PCLK cycle.

BitField.description: Transmit Reset\nNote: It is cleared automatically after one PCLK cycle.
BitField.name: TXRST

BitField.description: Receive Reset\nNote 1: It is cleared automatically after one PCLK cycle.\nNote 2: It is suggested to check the RXBUSY (UUART_PROTSTS[10]) before this bit will be set to 1.

BitField.description: Function Mode\nThis bit field selects the protocol for this USCI controller. Selecting a protocol that is not available or a reserved combination disables the USCI. When switching between two protocols, the USCI has to be disabled before selecting a new protocol. Simultaneously, the USCI will be reset when user write 000 to FUNMODE.\nNote: Other bit combinations are reserved.
BitField.name: FUNMODE

BitField.description: Transmit Start Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a transmit start event.\nNote: The transmit start event happens when hardware starts to move TX data from data buffer to shift data unit.
BitField.name: TXSTIEN

BitField.description: Transmit End Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a transmit finish event.\nNote: The transmit finish event happens when hardware sends the last bit of TX data from shift data unit.
BitField.name: TXENDIEN

BitField.description: Receive Start Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a receive start event.\nNote: For SPI master mode, the receive start event happens when SPI master sends slave select active and spi clock to the external SPI slave. For SPI slave mode, the receive start event happens when slave select of SPI slave is active and spi clock of SPI slave is inputed from the external SPI master.
BitField.name: RXSTIEN

BitField.description: Receive End Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a receive finish event.\nNote: The receive finish event happens when hardware receives the last bit of RX data into shift data unit.
BitField.name: RXENDIEN

BitField.name: CLKDIV

BitField.description: Data Output Inverse Selection\nThis bit defines the relation between the internal shift data value and the output data signal of USCIx_DAT0/1 pin.
BitField.name: DATOINV

BitField.description: Control Signal Output Inverse Selection\nThis bit defines the relation between the internal control signal and the output control signal.\nNote: The control signal has different definitions in different protocol. In SPI protocol, the control signal means slave select signal.

BitField.description:
Word Length of Transmission
This bit field defines the data word length (amount of bits) for reception and transmission. The data word is always right-aligned in the data buffer. USCI support word length from 4 to 16 bits.
0x0: The data word contains 16 bits located at bit positions [15:0].
0x1: Reserved.
0x2: Reserved.
0x3: Reserved.
0x4: The data word contains 4 bits located at bit positions [3:0].
0x5: The data word contains 5 bits located at bit positions [4:0].
...
0xF: The data word contains 15 bits located at bit positions [14:0].
BitField.name: DWIDTH

BitField.description: Transmit Data\nSoftware can use this bit field to write 16-bit transmit data for transmission. In order to avoid overwriting the transmit data, user have to check TXEMPTY (USPI_BUFSTS[8]) status before writing transmit data into this bit field.

User can enable TX PDMA function firstly or enable both functions simultaneously.\nNote 2: In SPI Master mode with full duplex transfer, if both TX and RX PDMA functions are enabled, TX PDMA function cannot be disabled prior to RX PDMA function. User can disable RX PDMA function firstly or disable both functions simultaneously.

BitField.description: Slave 3-wire Mode Selection (Slave Only)\nThe SPI protocol can work with 3-wire interface (without slave select signal) in Slave mode.
BitField.name: SLV3WIRE

BitField.description: Slave Select Control (Master Only)\nIf AUTOSS bit is cleared, setting this bit to 1 will set the slave select signal to active state, and setting this bit to 0 will set the slave select signal back to inactive state.\nNote: In SPI protocol, the internal slave select signal is active high.

BitField.description: Serial Bus Clock Mode\nThis bit field defines the SCLK idle status, data transmit, and data receive edge.

BitField.description:
Suspend Interval (Master Only)
This bit field provides the configurable suspend interval between two successive transmit/receive transaction in a transfer. The definition of the suspend interval is the interval between the last clock edge of the preceding transaction word and the first clock edge of the following transaction word. The default value is 0x3. The period of the suspend interval is obtained according to the following equation.
 (SUSPITV + 0.5) * period of SPI_CLK clock cycle
Example:
BitField.name: SUSPITV

BitField.description: Transmit Data Mode Selection\nThis bit field describes how receive and transmit data is shifted in and out.\nNote: Changing the value of this bit field will produce the TXRST and RXRST to clear the TX/RX data buffer automatically.
BitField.name: TSMSEL

BitField.description: Slave Mode Time-out Period (Slave Only)\nIn Slave mode, this bit field is used for Slave time-out period. This bit field indicates how many clock periods (selected by TMCNTSRC, USPI_BRGEN[5]) between the two edges of input SCLK will assert the Slave time-out event. Writing 0x0 into this bit field will disable the Slave time-out function.\nExample: Assume SLVTOCNT is 0x0A and TMCNTSRC (USPI_BRGEN[5]) is 1, it means the time-out event will occur if the state of SPI bus clock pin is not changed more than (10+1) periods of fDIV_CLK.
BitField.name: SLVTOCNT

BitField.description: Transmit Under-run Data Polarity (for Slave)\nThis bit defines the transmitting data level of USCIx_DAT1 when no data is available for transferring.
BitField.name: TXUDRPOL

BitField.description: SPI Protocol Enable Bit
BitField.name: PROTEN

BitField.description: Slave Select Inactive Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables/disables the generation of a slave select interrupt if the slave select changes to inactive.
BitField.name: SSINAIEN

BitField.description: Slave Select Active Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables/disables the generation of a slave select interrupt if the slave select changes to active.
BitField.name: SSACTIEN

BitField.description: Slave Time-out Interrupt Enable Bit\nIn SPI protocol, this bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a Slave time-out event.
BitField.name: SLVTOIEN

BitField.description: Slave Mode Bit Count Error Interrupt Enable Bit\nIf data transfer is terminated by slave time-out or slave select inactive event in Slave mode, so that the transmit/receive data bit count does not match the setting of DWIDTH (USPI_LINECTL[11:8]). Bit count error event occurs.
BitField.name: SLVBEIEN

BitField.description: Transmit Start Interrupt Flag\nNote: It is cleared by software write 1 to this bit. The transmit start event happens when hardware starts to move TX data from data buffer to shift data unit.
BitField.name: TXSTIF

BitField.description: Transmit End Interrupt Flag\nNote: It is cleared by software write 1 to this bit. The transmit end event happens when hardware sends the last bit of TX data from shift data unit.
BitField.name: TXENDIF

BitField.description: Receive Start Interrupt Flag\nNote: It is cleared by software write 1 to this bit. For SPI master mode, the receive start event happens when SPI master sends slave select active and spi clock to the external SPI slave. For SPI slave mode, the receive start event happens when slave select of SPI slave is active and spi clock of SPI slave is inputed from the external SPI master.
BitField.name: RXSTIF

BitField.description: Receive End Interrupt Flag\nNote: It is cleared by software write 1 to this bit. The receive end event happens when hardware receives the last bit of RX data into shift data unit.
BitField.name: RXENDIF

BitField.description: Slave Time-out Interrupt Flag (for Slave Only)\nNote: It is cleared by software write 1 to this bit
BitField.name: SLVTOIF

BitField.description: Slave Bit Count Error Interrupt Flag (for Slave Only)\nNote 1: It is cleared by software write 1 to this bit. If the transmit/receive data bit count does not match the setting of DWIDTH (USPI_LINECTL[11:8]), bit count error event occurs.\nNote 2: SLVBEIF fix to 0 when slave 3-wire mode enable.
BitField.name: SLVBEIF

BitField.description:
Slave Select Inactive Interrupt Flag (for Slave Only)
This bit indicates that the internal slave select signal has changed to inactive. It is cleared by software writes 1 to this bit
Note 1: The internal slave select signal is active high.
Note 2: SSINAIF fix to 0 when slave 3-wire mode enable.
BitField.name: SSINAIF

BitField.description:
Slave Select Active Interrupt Flag (for Slave Only)
This bit indicates that the internal slave select signal has changed to active. It is cleared by software writes one to this bit.
Note 1: The internal slave select signal is active high.
Note 2: SSACTIF fix to 0 when slave 3-wire mode enable.
BitField.name: SSACTIF

BitField.description: Slave Select Line Bus Status (Read Only)\nThis bit is only available in Slave mode. It used to monitor the current status of the input slave select signal on the bus.
BitField.name: SSLINE

BitField.description: Busy Status (Read Only)
BitField.name: BUSY

BitField.description: Slave Mode Transmit Under-run Status (Read Only)\nIn Slave mode, if there is no available transmit data in buffer while transmit data shift out caused by input serial bus clock, this status flag will be set to 1. This bit indicates whether the current shift-out data of word transmission is switched to TXUDRPOL (USPI_PROTCTL[28]) or not.
BitField.name: SLVUDR

BitField.description: Function Mode\nThis bit field selects the protocol for this USCI controller. Selecting a protocol that is not available or a reserved combination disables the USCI. When switching between two protocols, the USCI has to be disabled before selecting a new protocol. Simultaneously, the USCI will be reset when user write 000 to FUNMODE.\nNote: Other bit combinations are reserved.
BitField.name: FUNMODE

BitField.description: Transmit Start Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a transmit start event.\nNote: The transmit start event happens when hardware starts to move TX data from data buffer to shift data unit.
BitField.name: TXSTIEN

BitField.description: Transmit End Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a transmit finish event.\nNote: The transmit finish event happens when hardware sends the last bit of TX data from shift data unit.
BitField.name: TXENDIEN

BitField.description: Receive Start Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a receive start event.\nNote: For SPI master mode, the receive start event happens when SPI master sends slave select active and spi clock to the external SPI slave. For SPI slave mode, the receive start event happens when slave select of SPI slave is active and spi clock of SPI slave is inputed from the external SPI master.
BitField.name: RXSTIEN

BitField.description: Receive End Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a receive finish event.\nNote: The receive finish event happens when hardware receives the last bit of RX data into shift data unit.
BitField.name: RXENDIEN

BitField.description: Reference Clock Source Selection\nThis bit selects the source of reference clock (fREF_CLK).
BitField.name: RCLKSEL

BitField.description: Protocol Clock Source Selection\nThis bit selects the source of protocol clock (fPROT_CLK).
BitField.name: PTCLKSEL

BitField.description: Sample Clock Source Selection\nThis bit field used for the clock source selection of sample clock (fSAMP_CLK) for the protocol processor.
BitField.name: SPCLKSEL

BitField.description: Time Measurement Counter Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the 10-bit timing measurement counter.
BitField.name: TMCNTEN

BitField.description: Time Measurement Counter Clock Source Selection
BitField.name: TMCNTSRC

BitField.description: Clock Divider
BitField.name: CLKDIV

Register.description: USCI Input Data Signal Configuration Register 0
Register.name: USPI_DATIN0

BitField.description: Input Signal Synchronization Selection\nThis bit selects if the un-synchronized input signal (with optionally inverted) or the synchronized (and optionally filtered) signal, which is synchronized with PCLK, can be used as input for the data shift unit.\nNote: In SPI protocol, it is suggested this bit should be set as 0.
BitField.name: SYNCSEL

BitField.description: Input Signal Inverse Selection\nThis bit defines the inverter enable of the input asynchronous signal.\nNote: In SPI protocol, it is suggested this bit should be set as 0.
BitField.name: ININV

Register.description: USCI Input Control Signal Configuration Register 0
Register.name: USPI_CTLIN0

BitField.description: Input Synchronization Signal Selection\nThis bit selects if the un-synchronized input signal (with optionally inverted) or the synchronized (and optionally filtered) signal, which is synchronized with PCLK, can be used as input for the data shift unit.\nNote: In SPI protocol, it is suggested this bit should be set as 0.
BitField.name: SYNCSEL

BitField.description: Input Signal Inverse Selection\nThis bit defines the inverter enable of the input asynchronous signal.
BitField.name: ININV

Register.description: USCI Input Clock Signal Configuration Register
Register.name: USPI_CLKIN

BitField.description: Input Synchronization Signal Selection\nThis bit selects if the un-synchronized input signal or the synchronized (and optionally filtered) signal, which is synchronized with PCLK, can be used as input for the data shift unit.\nNote: In SPI protocol, it is suggested this bit should be set as 0.
BitField.name: SYNCSEL

BitField.description: LSB First Transmission Selection
BitField.name: LSB

BitField.description: Data Output Inverse Selection\nThis bit defines the relation between the internal shift data value and the output data signal of USCIx_DAT0/1 pin.
BitField.name: DATOINV

BitField.description: Control Signal Output Inverse Selection\nThis bit defines the relation between the internal control signal and the output control signal.\nNote: The control signal has different definitions in different protocol. In SPI protocol, the control signal means slave select signal.
BitField.name: CTLOINV

BitField.description:
Word Length of Transmission
This bit field defines the data word length (amount of bits) for reception and transmission. The data word is always right-aligned in the data buffer. USCI support word length from 4 to 16 bits.
0x0: The data word contains 16 bits located at bit positions [15:0].
0x1: Reserved.
0x2: Reserved.
0x3: Reserved.
0x4: The data word contains 4 bits located at bit positions [3:0].
0x5: The data word contains 5 bits located at bit positions [4:0].
...
0xF: The data word contains 15 bits located at bit positions [14:0].
BitField.name: DWIDTH

BitField.description: Transmit Data\nSoftware can use this bit field to write 16-bit transmit data for transmission. In order to avoid overwriting the transmit data, user have to check TXEMPTY (USPI_BUFSTS[8]) status before writing transmit data into this bit field.
BitField.name: TXDAT

BitField.description: Port Direction Control
BitField.name: PORTDIR

BitField.description: Received Data\nThis bit field monitors the received data which stored in receive data buffer.
BitField.name: RXDAT

BitField.description: Slave Transmit Under-run Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: TXUDRIEN

BitField.description: Clear Transmit Buffer \nNote: It is cleared automatically after one PCLK cycle.
BitField.name: TXCLR

BitField.description: Receive Buffer Overrun Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: RXOVIEN

BitField.description: Clear Receive Buffer\nNote: It is cleared automatically after one PCLK cycle.
BitField.name: RXCLR

BitField.description: Transmit Reset
BitField.name: TXRST

BitField.description: Receive Reset\nNote: It is cleared automatically after one PCLK cycle.
BitField.name: RXRST

BitField.description: Receive Buffer Empty Indicator
BitField.name: RXEMPTY

BitField.description: Receive Buffer Full Indicator
BitField.name: RXFULL

BitField.description: Receive Buffer Over-run Interrupt Status\nThis bit indicates that a receive buffer overrun event has been detected. If RXOVIEN (USPI_BUFCTL[14]) is enabled, the corresponding interrupt request is activated. It is cleared by software writes 1 to this bit.
BitField.name: RXOVIF

BitField.description: Transmit Buffer Empty Indicator
BitField.name: TXEMPTY

BitField.description: Transmit Buffer Full Indicator
BitField.name: TXFULL

BitField.description: Transmit Buffer Under-run Interrupt Status\nThis bit indicates that a transmit buffer under-run event has been detected. If enabled by TXUDRIEN (USPI_BUFCTL[6]), the corresponding interrupt request is activated. It is cleared by software writes 1 to this bit
BitField.name: TXUDRIF

BitField.description: PDMA Reset
BitField.name: PDMARST

BitField.description: PDMA Transmit Channel Available\nNote 1: In SPI Master mode with full duplex transfer, if both TX and RX PDMA functions are enabled, RX PDMA function cannot be enabled prior to TX PDMA function. User can enable TX PDMA function firstly or enable both functions simultaneously.\nNote 2: In SPI Master mode with full duplex transfer, if both TX and RX PDMA functions are enabled, TX PDMA function cannot be disabled prior to RX PDMA function. User can disable RX PDMA function firstly or disable both functions simultaneously.
BitField.name: TXPDMAEN

BitField.description: PDMA Receive Channel Available
BitField.name: RXPDMAEN

BitField.description: PDMA Mode Enable Bit
BitField.name: PDMAEN

BitField.description: Wake-up Enable Bit
BitField.name: WKEN

BitField.description: Power Down Blocking Option
BitField.name: PDBOPT

BitField.description: Wake-up Flag\nWhen chip is woken up from Power-down mode, this bit is set to 1. Software can write 1 to clear this bit.
BitField.name: WKF

BitField.description: Slave Mode Selection
BitField.name: SLAVE
